query:
SELECT au.id as app_user_id, au.email, au.tokenBalance,
       tt.id, tt.amount, tt.reason, tt.description, tt.balanceAfter, tt.createdAt
FROM app_users au
LEFT JOIN token_transactions tt ON tt.appUserId = au.id
WHERE au.email = 'ladaatn@gmail.com'
ORDER BY tt.createdAt DESC;
